pages.seoDescription: Who Petal & Post is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A bright flower shop full of fresh seasonal bouquets in bloom

children: Petal & Post is a small, cheerful flower shop on the corner — the kind of place you can pop into for a last-minute bunch or plan something special weeks ahead.
We buy fresh and local wherever we can, arrange everything by hand, and genuinely love helping you pick flowers for the good days and the hard ones alike.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: We follow what’s actually growing, so your flowers are at their best and last longer on the table.
Birthdays and big celebrations, quiet sympathy flowers, or just a Tuesday pick-me-up — all equally welcome.
Same-day local delivery, standing orders for nearby offices, and workshops that bring people in the door.
